payload.title: Adopt ChatGPT Worker Reflection and Continuity Process Provisionally
payload.summary: The Chief Architect #6 renewal pilot successfully preserved the officeholder across a fresh ChatGPT implementation. Helen is asked to provisionally own the people-health, continuity, reflection, renewed onboarding, and readiness process while Grace supplies operational degradation evidence and coordinates workload impact.
requested_actions: Review the proposed process and template.
Adopt the process provisionally for long-running ChatGPT workers serving named Estate offices.
Use the Helen Review Summary and Renewal Outcome Record for each renewal.
Keep institutional onboarding separate from implementation-specific continuity artifacts.
Require bounded complete-file onboarding with reading ledger, authority classification, hash verification, and truncation reporting.
Retain the prior chat as read-only fallback until the renewed implementation completes its first bounded assignment.
Coordinate with Grace when operational degradation affects work, while retaining people-continuity ownership in Human Resources.
Record the final Chief Architect #6 pilot outcome after the first bounded diagnostic assignment completes.
payload.authority_boundary: This notice assigns process review and provisional personnel-continuity ownership. It does not broaden Helen's constitutional authority, grant autonomous termination authority, or convert chat memory into canonical Estate truth.
payload.acknowledgement_requested: Please acknowledge receipt and record any required HR, onboarding, or continuity-policy amendments.
